candidate.text:
Let the initial volume in the tank be 5485 litres. 

First, transfer 14/47 of the tank to the smaller tank. The volume transferred is (14/47) * 5485 litres.  
(14/47) * 5485 = 14 * (5485 / 47) = 14 * 116.6170212766 = 1632.738285714
So, the smaller tank initially has 1632.738285714 litres.

Next, remove 9 litres from the smaller tank. The volume becomes 1632.738285714 - 9 = 1623.738285714 litres.

Then, drain 9/47 of what remains. The volume drained is (9/47) * 1623.738285714 = 9 * (1623.738285714 / 47) = 9 * 34.5084230638 = 310.5758073142
So, the volume remaining in the smaller tank is 1623.738285714 - 310.5758073142 = 1313.1624783998

Finally, add 9 litres. The volume becomes 1313.1624783998 + 9 = 1322.1624783998 litres.

Rounding to two decimal places, the volume in the smaller tank is 1322.16 litres.
